name: Alok
introEn: Active aura that heals Alok and nearby allies and boosts their movement speed.
introHi: Active aura that heals Alok and nearby allies and boosts their movement speed.
currentEn: Creates a 5m aura that increases movement speed by 15% and restores 5 HP/s for 10 seconds. Multiple Drop the Beat auras do not stack.
currentHi: Creates a 5m aura that increases movement speed by 15% and restores 5 HP/s for 10 seconds. Multiple Drop the Beat auras do not stack.
notesEn: While Alok's own skill is active, teammates' Alok auras give no benefit (OB53). Movement speed has a global maximum; bonuses from skills, items and events cannot exceed it (OB54).
notesHi: While Alok's own skill is active, teammates' Alok auras give no benefit (OB53). Movement speed has a global maximum; bonuses from skills, items and events cannot exceed it (OB54).
historyEn: OB39 (Mar 2023): HP recovery 5 to 3 HP/s, cooldown 50s to 45s.
OB45 (24 Jun 2024): HP recovery 3 to 5 HP/s, movement speed 15%, duration 10s, cooldown 45s.
OB52 (9 Jan 2026): Fixed skill range not matching the visual range, and speed boost sometimes failing to apply.
OB53 (2 Apr 2026): Alok users no longer gain from teammates' Alok auras while their own skill is active.
OB54 (23 Jun 2026): 9th Anniversary event Skill Boosts added: Speed Remix (10m aura, teammates +16% speed) and Heal Remix (20 HP/s while active). Global movement-speed cap added.
historyHi: OB39 (Mar 2023): HP recovery 5 to 3 HP/s, cooldown 50s to 45s.

OB54 (23 Jun 2026): 9th Anniversary event Skill Boosts added: Speed Remix (10m aura, teammates +16% speed) and Heal Remix (20 HP/s while active). Global movement-speed cap added.

name: A124
introEn: Electromagnetic wave that blocks enemy skills, deals damage and interrupts interactions.
introHi: Electromagnetic wave that blocks enemy skills, deals damage and interrupts interactions.
currentEn: Unleashes an 8m electromagnetic wave. Enemies inside cannot activate skills, take 25 DMG, and have their interaction countdowns (such as reviving) interrupted.
currentHi: Unleashes an 8m electromagnetic wave. Enemies inside cannot activate skills, take 25 DMG, and have their interaction countdowns (such as reviving) interrupted.
notesEn: Skill can be cancelled while aiming. Joseph is immune to A124's interference.
notesHi: Skill can be cancelled while aiming. Joseph is immune to A124's interference.
